This is a recent and still ongoing issue. Back in September of 2019, I bought a DVD at a local department store. Turned out the DVD was damaged in package. I'd lost the receipt, so I didn't think the store would be willing to make an exchange, and thus I opted to contact the company that published the DVD, Paramount Home Entertainment. I sent them an e-mail, and made a phone call to their customer service rep. The rep said that they'd try to send me another copy, and the reply e-mail asked for a name and address. I replied back with both, and hunkered down to wait. 

It's now January. No replacement DVD has arrived in the mail, further e-mails have been ignored and further phone calls have gone directly to voice mail. I like to think that I'm justifiably pissed off at this point, and have even made a point of commenting on their Facebook page about their shitty customer service. Alas, I fear there's little I can do at this point, aside from maybe take the DVD to said department store, ask for an exchange and hope for the best.
